sourceProvenance.title: A Canoa Virou
sourceProvenance.edition: Familiar Brazilian two-stanza circle-game form (A canoa virou / Se eu fosse um peixinho), independently notated in A major; pitch order cross-checked against reviewed tablature and regional references; the later Siri pra ca refrain is intentionally excluded; Pianify editorial left-hand harmony v1
sourceProvenance.license: Public Domain (traditional Brazilian musical work; only the two-stanza traditional form is used); third-party reference files are not redistributed
normalization: The first sounding note is normalized to 0 seconds.
Exact simultaneous duplicate pitches are reduced to one note.
Repeated pitches are separated by a 20 ms release gap when the source sustain overlaps the next attack.
No pitch is transposed and no source note is removed to fit the visual keyboard.

sourceReference.provider: Universidade Estadual do Sudoeste da Bahia / ProfHistoria
sourceReference.reproducedSource: Pedro Fernandes Tomas, Cancoes Portuguesas, Coimbra, 1934, p. 85
sourceReference.redistribution: not bundled; retained as an external historical research reference

derivation.scorePage: Prefeitura do Rio, Reforco Rio 2022, Fasciculo 18 (traditional Brazilian text/form); historical attestation reproduced from Pedro Fernandes Tomas, 1934, p. 85, in the UESB thesis at printed p. 20
derivation.melody: independent Pianify notation of the public-domain Brazilian two-stanza form; pitch sequence and regional rhythmic variants were cross-checked without bundling any third-party tablature, score, MIDI, or recording; the separately attributed Siri pra ca refrain is excluded
derivation.harmony: Pianify editorial piano harmonization v1, clearly separated from the traditional melody
